decisive_items: heterozygous mutation in exon 3 of the ELANE gene
Liver tissue showed scattered hepatic structures with focal abscess changes
response.rationale: ELANE mutation and rare neutrophils indicate a neutrophil disorder causing recurrent infections and hepatic abscess; R2 is the local complication, R3 (CGD) is not supported by ELANE genotype.

rejected.why: ELANE mutation is specific to severe congenital neutropenia, not chronic granulomatous disease which involves NADPH oxidase defects.
Liver abscess is a secondary infectious complication rather than the underlying systemic diagnosis.
